neighbours.label: the adverb ' highly' as an intensifier ('highly recommend', 'highly likely', 'highly skilled'), as against other intensifiers and the adjective 'high'
fire: Critics have highly praised the new production of the opera.
Reviewers say the restaurant is highly regarded for its seafood.
It seems highly probable that the vote will be delayed again.
The company makes highly accurate sensors for aircraft engines.
These mushrooms are highly toxic and should never be eaten raw.
My neighbour is a highly experienced pilot who flew for thirty years.
The report was highly critical of the council's planning decisions.
Her latest album is highly anticipated by fans around the world.
quiet: Critics have warmly praised the new production of the opera.
Reviewers say the restaurant is well regarded for its seafood.
It seems quite probable that the vote will be delayed again.
The company makes very accurate sensors for aircraft engines.
These mushrooms are extremely toxic and should never be eaten raw.
My neighbour is an experienced pilot who flew at high altitude for thirty years.
The report was sharply critical of the council's planning decisions.
Her latest album is eagerly awaited by fans around the world.

notes: Card peaks: ' highly' x23 ('highly secure', 'highly recommends', 'highly likely', 'highly unlikely', 'highly-anticipated'), 'High|ly', '高度'.
